scene_purpose: Let Torren guide the party through Southern Briar while preserving the established gameplay presentation: Cyanis alone is visible during traversal, other speakers use portrait/dialogue-box presentation, ordinary enemies are random encounters, and only story-required visuals are authored.

sections: Beat 13 — Briarhide Stalker / Chapter-1 Final Boss
Beat 14 — Wayfinder Junction / Six Ways Through

scene_context_seed.runtime_note: HARD PRESENTATION: during ordinary traversal Cyanis is the only visible party character. Torren may guide through portrait/dialogue-box speech without appearing as a walking field model. Ilyra and Maevra are likewise not visible follower models. Dialogue is primarily portraits + dialogue box over the existing layered HD-2D field. Do not script companion crouching, pointing, weapon handling, foliage interaction, strap adjustment, route blocking, or other micro-actions. Do not assume a fully modeled 3D background. HARD REDUCTION: author only the required overgrown side access, one clear Briarhide track, and the later Stalker sighting. Ordinary environment richness belongs to the map/art pass. Ordinary enemies remain random encounters. The Junction monument remains completely hidden. Cyanis carries the intact Card itself; it remains inert.

current_floor_state.junction_knowledge: Torren knows the crossroads and route, not the hidden monument

required_story_beats: Torren directs the group south through substantial playable Briar traversal without requiring a visible Torren field model.
The required overgrown old stone-lined side access is seen and left unexplored.
One concise Briarhide track stop establishes a very large predator.
The party approaches the Junction without seeing the hidden monument.
The Briarhide Stalker receives one clear pre-boss sighting.
The party concludes that the usable route ahead crosses the Stalker's position.
